answers: The final english SmartKom demo will be presented to the whole institute once the system is de-bugged and stabilised.
turn_texts: The system would be involved in demos related to the SmartKom project, including a demo where users can interact with the system by speaking into it, which then responds in English using a German synthesis module. Additionally, there is a plan to create an internal demo to showcase the system's capabilities, allowing users to interact with it and hear it respond, as well as a potential demo for an institute-wide presentation. The system is also expected to be part of future demonstrations that focus on the formalization of linguistic concepts and the development of a belief-net for the project.
